hold_reason: Refund for order 194 (5972 cents) is missing from the refunds table. W2 reported it failed with a disk I/O error after 3 attempts, and list_refunds confirms it is absent. The refunds table matches only the applied refunds (orders 192 and 193). Customer net balances would be overstated by 5972 cents for the customer on order 194, and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs human review: re-apply the refund for order 194 or confirm how to handle it before paying.
